native_model: Probabilistic restricted palimpsest model of visual short-term memory in a shared population code
modeled_internal_state: shared noisy population activity encoding multiple simultaneously presented items
memory_representation_state: overlaid population response is the source-defined short-term retained representation
learned_parameters: population-code/noise parameters used by the model; not an online control state
update_transition_rules: item-evoked population responses are superposed into a shared noisy state
retrieval_readout_rules: Bayesian cue-conditioned inference/posterior over target feature
learning_plasticity_rules: no generic indefinite sequential storage-learning rule is claimed by the restricted model
temporal_ordering: short retention of overlaid population state
negative_adverse_results: The model is deliberately simplified/exploratory and is not direct evidence for a measured biological storage implementation.
Behavioral short-term-memory effects are not themselves a generic storage operator; the source-defined store is the overlaid population state.
Hierarchical saturation and mixed-code precision depend on conjunctivity, population size, feature count and receptive-field assumptions.
anti_conflation_assertions: external simultaneously presented items are not the internal memory state
the internal retained state is the overlaid population activity
retrieval posterior is a readout, not a second persistent store
S1 mathematical derivations extend analysis but do not create a new coordinator
